description: Use this before buying more than one product: spreads an amount over several sources of yield instead of putting everything into the single highest yield. Returns the blocks (one product per category, never the same exposure twice, each checked at its own amount incl. gas, weight capped), a 10 % admixture above the risk budget for extra yield, the median yield and risk per category, the blended yield vs. the single best, the worst single failure as % of the amount, and a guide written for agents: why spreading is better (with failures on record), the steps (then get_purchase_steps per block) and when to rebalance. Checks, not advice.

max_risk.description: Highest risk level for the core blocks (default 3)

price_exposure.description: Allow blocks that move with a crypto price, e.g. staking or pools with ETH (default false)

name: build_portfolio
title: Build a diversified portfolio
